summary: Build AI assurance plans, risk registers, and testing controls for audit, procurement, and oversight. Explore the five-day course.
lede: AI assurance training helps audit, risk, compliance, programme and procurement teams evaluate AI systems throughout their lifecycle. Participants learn to define assurance scope, prioritize risks, plan fairness and robustness tests, and assemble privacy, security, monitoring, and vendor-control evidence. They also practise tracing findings into action plans and board reporting, using frameworks including the NIST AI Risk Management Framework and ISO/IEC 42001:2023.
audienceIntro: This course is designed for professionals who assess, oversee, procure, or audit AI systems and need practical assurance controls across internal and third-party deployments.
modules: AI Internal Audit and Independent Review
AI Assurance Reporting and Action Plans
prerequisites: Prior exposure to AI governance, risk management, internal audit, compliance, or procurement is useful. No coding or model-building is required; exercises focus on scoping, evidence review, testing design, and assurance documentation.
